meta_description:
sadaf_hussain on August 31, 2026: "Long before the breakfast call, Delhi wakes up with chai and pappe (rusk), and if you have attended any of the walks that I conduct or you're from Delhi, you know what I am talking about. It is not a bed tea but a quick meal to welcome your day, or let's say, silence before the city's noisy streets and busy life embrace you.

Video by @asadonfeeds and special behind the scene appearance by @zaidsyedmohd 😃".
